newsitem.title: USA: Dow off more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow off more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in early morning trading on Monday as Wall Street turned cautious ahead of Tuesday's meeting of the Federal Reserve's policy-setting body.
At 10:03 a.m. EDT (1403 GMT), the index of 30 blue-chip issues lost 54.96 points at 7,632.76, which activated the
New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
